subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given phrase.

All of a sudden
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**)

__
 
• The phrase **"All of a sudden"** means something that happens **quickly and without warning; unexpectedly**. (अचानक)

 
 
• **Example: **All of a sudden, the lights went out during the performance.
 
 
 
• **"Quickly and unexpectedly"** refers to an event or action that occurs suddenly and without prior notice. (तेजी से और अप्रत्याशित रूप से)
 
 
• **Example: **The storm arrived **quickly and unexpectedly,** catching everyone off guard.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: ***Quickly and unexpectedly.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Intentionally** (जानबूझकर): Done with purpose or intent.

 
 
• **Example:** He** intentionally** left the door open to let the cat out.
 
 
 
• **Quickly and Expectedly** (तेजी से और अपेक्षित रूप से): Happens fast and as anticipated.
 
 
• **Example:** The train arrived **quickly and expectedly**, right on schedule.
 
 
 
• **Accidentally** (दुर्घटनावश): Occurs by chance or by mistake.
 
 
• **Example:** She **accidentally **spilled coffee on her shirt.

The correct answer is **Option 2**.</div&g
